notes: Since v3.0.0: Expanded the v3 activity/emote set with 20+ plushie and social actions. Added shared room emote chains, including Start a Wave Emote with left-to-right sequencing. Wave participants now raise both arms for 3 seconds and return to BC's BaseUpper arm pose. Added Raise Both Arms with a 5-second temporary OverTheHead pose and reliable BaseUpper reset. Added Measure Height with dynamic height-comparison chat text and sender-side local rendering. Added nickname-aware dialogue so action text uses character nicknames/display names correctly. Updated plushie action dialogue to include the selected plushie's name where appropriate. Added expression reactions for supported activities. Added activity/search improvements for the extra/social action menus. Removed the automatic hourly room-mascot cycle; mascot changes are manual. Updated room mascot behavior and compatibility handling. Moved poke-style jealousy behavior into Jealous and added boop/bap handling to Protect. Changed affection idle decay to -1 every 8 hours for plushies that are not currently being held. Held plushies are excluded from idle affection decay. Improved drag/move/resize persistence and plushie positioning behavior. Improved gender-aware and possessive action text. Improved synced/non-local emote and custom activity networking. Improved custom activity packet normalization so plugin actions survive R132 activity packet differences. Improved sender-side chat rendering and duplicate suppression for custom plugin actions. Added arm-pose diagnostics and console helpers for testing/resetting temporary poses. Added Rey plushie using assets/plushies/rey.png. Added Rey's built-in lore. Added Margot plushie using assets/plushies/margot.png. Added a hidden-lore placeholder for Margot. Preserved legacy Subbycat wire option 18 for backwards compatibility while adding Rey and Margot. Expanded the public plushie count to 20. Kept Opera/R132-compatible bootstrap and userscript loading behavior.

changes: Started the v3 release line.
Expanded the activity/emote system with 20+ new actions and emotes.
Removed automatic hourly mascot cycling.
Added shared emote-chain support and expression reactions.
Added nickname-aware dialogue and improved plushie-name-aware action text.
Added extra/social activity improvements and search support.
Changed idle affection decay to -1 every 8 hours for unheld plushies.
Updated Protect/Jealous action keyword behavior.
Added temporary raised-arm pose handling and arm-pose diagnostics.
Made pending custom activities authoritative during outgoing R132 activity packets.
Improved Raise Arms, shared Wave, and Measure Height dispatch/network behavior.
Renamed the wave activity to Start a Wave Emote.
Changed arm action wording to Raise Both Arms.
Improved sender-side Measure Height rendering.
Added direct local chat rendering for outgoing custom actions.
Added duplicate suppression for matching server echoes.
Set Wave arm hold time to exactly 3 seconds.
Improved temporary arm-pose restoration logic.
Changed temporary arm reset behavior toward a consistent base posture.
Fixed the arm reset correctly by replacing OverTheHead with BaseUpper.
Kept BaseLower/lower-body pose independent from upper-body arm resetting.
Added SubbysPlushiesArmReset() diagnostic helper.
Added Rey plushie and built-in Rey lore.
Added Margot plushie with hidden lore.
Preserved legacy Subbycat wire option 18.
Expanded public plushie count to 20.
Fixed the stale internal bootstrap version so all v3.1.9 version constants match.
